_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact - the five named monetary rows (300 + 200 + 500 + 500 + 1900) sum to 3,400.00, equal to the page's own underlined total '$3400.00' and to the module's stated cover figure. IN-KIND, EXCLUDED FROM THE SUM: one row, 'Republican Party' $1,200.00 for Printing, printed BELOW the underlined $3400.00 total under its own heading 'In Kind Donation Printing' - the filer's own layout puts it outside the monetary total, which is independent confirmation of the wave's monetary-only reading of the cover contribution figure. No specimen rows exist on this document (it is not the county form). $1,900.00 of the $3,400.00 - 56% - is the candidate's own money, itemized as a donor line in his own name.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of exactly $200.00, and it is the FILER'S ARITHMETIC, retained as filed and never repaired. The expense column prints six labelled lines, five of them with amounts: Postage 1,728.00 + Milage & Expenses 400.00 + Advertize 850.00 + Signs 512.00 + Stakes 80.00 = 3,570.00. The filer's own underlined total, written directly beneath the rule he drew under the column, is '$3370.00' - which is also the cover figure and is the number his closing balance uses (3,400.00 - 3,370.00 = the printed '+30.00'), so the error is in the addition of the column, not in the carry-forward. ESCALATION: every one of the five amounts was re-read as a TIGHT VALUE CROP at 900-1200 dpi before this delta was accepted, because 1,728 alone would explain it if it were 1,528. It is not: the second digit is heavily over-inked but is unambiguously a 2, and it is formed identically to the 2 in Ted Levy's '$200' on the same page in the same hand (this filer's 2 closes like a lower-case 'a'). 400.00, 850.00, 512.00 and 80.00 each re-read clean at 900 dpi. Per GOTCHAS, arithmetic outranks a glyph re-read - but here the arithmetic has no single doubtful digit to land on (1,728->1,528, 400->200, 850->650 and 512->312 would each close it equally well), so there is nothing to decide and the honest record is the filer's own inconsistency. The sixth line, 'Registration', is a labelled expense with NO AMOUNT WRITTEN AT ALL; it is carried as a real row with a blank amount rather than dropped, because dropping it would silently assert the filer had no registration expense.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: THE BRIEF'S EXPECTATION IS HALF RIGHT AND HALF WRONG. 1273 is indeed a one-page handwritten NARRATIVE LETTER (form_variant='narrative_letter') with no county form, no column box and no ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION/EXPENSE REPORT page - but it is NOT a bare cover: the single page IS the ledger, and it names every donor and every expense purpose with an amount. Both sides are therefore 'transcribed', NOT 'none'. p1 prints its own two underlined section totals in the filer's hand: '$3400.00' under the contribution column and '$3370.00' under the expense column, and below them the closing balance '$ + 30.00' (= 3400 - 3370), which is exactly the module's stated cover triple. CONTRIBUTIONS GATE: the five named rows sum to 3,400.00 to the dollar = the printed total = the cover; the separately-headed 'In Kind Donation Printing / Republican Party $1200.00' sits OUTSIDE that total, so the filer himself treated the cover figure as MONETARY-ONLY (the McKenna in-kind precedent, reproduced here on a free-form letter). EXPENSE GATE: the column's five printed amounts sum to 3,570.00 against the filer's own printed 3,370.00 - a $200.00 FILER ARITHMETIC ERROR, retained as filed (see recon.expenditures).

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: David Ure, County Council, 2014 Post-Election, county RECEIVED stamp DEC 04 2014. SOURCE PROPERTIES THE BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE - all four are precedent candidates: (1) A NARRATIVE LETTER CAN STILL BE A FULL LEDGER. The chunk brief predicted both sides would be honestly 'none' (no schedule page exists). That is the wrong reading of this document: the one page carries five named contributors with amounts and six named expense purposes with amounts, plus its own two column totals. 'No form' is not 'no schedule' - the test is whether the document itemizes, not whether it uses the county's boxes. Both sides ship transcribed. (2) THE MONETARY-ONLY COVER IS CONFIRMED BY A FILER WHO HAD NO FORM TELLING HIM TO DO IT. Ure drew his own layout and still put the $1,200 in-kind printing donation below and outside his contribution total. (3) NO DATE COLUMN EXISTS ANYWHERE ON THE DOCUMENT. Every row therefore carries date='' with needs_review=1 (the 24239 precedent for a form with no date field); no date is inferred from the report date or the received stamp, and the flag is a property of the FORM, not a suspicion about any row. (4) AMOUNTS ARE WRITTEN WHOLE-DOLLAR WITH TRAILING PUNCTUATION - '$300.', '$200,', '$500,', '$1900,' - i.e. a terminal period or comma where the cents would go. This is the filer's punctuation, not a decimal comma and not a malformed decimal: the whole-dollar reading is proved by the column total '$3400.00', which closes only if each is read as whole dollars. Rule 10's decimal-comma whitelist is NOT invoked and no repair was made. PRIVACY: the document prints no addresses of any kind, so donor_city/donor_state are honestly blank on every row - LEFT UNWRITTEN BY THE FILER, not redacted by the county (this copy carries no black marker anywhere). NAMES: 'Ted Levy' and 'Tom Bartell' are the two least certain readings (cursive surnames, could be Long/Levy and Bartell/Bartelt) and carry confidence=low; the other three names are clean. GEOMETRY: this page has NO printed rules at all - it is a blank sheet - so rowbands can detect nothing and both frames are DECLARED (force_declared), fitted to the measured line pitch of the filer's own hand (2.95% of page height on the contribution block, 3.00% on the expense block) and spot-verified by re-cropping band 1 and band 8 of the contribution frame and band 1 of the expense frame. Rows are marked geometry_fit='declared' and must never be quoted as measured.
